e491dfa958fb8ebf437a1ce367e98d624a9371a7.summary: DataBreaches reports that the AlphV group added MeridianLink, a provider of a loan origination system and digital lending platform for financial institutions, to its leak site. According to AlphV, the November 7 attack involved data exfiltration but no encryption. AlphV also filed a complaint with the SEC alleging MeridianLink failed to file a disclosure under Item 1.05 of Form 8-K within four business days. MeridianLink said it identified a cybersecurity incident on Nov 10, contained it, and found no evidence of unauthorized access to production platforms. Its investigation is ongoing. The…
